scoring_notes: Recomputed from raw per-task CSV exactly as the site JS does: category score = arithmetic mean of that category's task scores (per categories_<release>.json; blank tasks skipped); Global/Overall = mean of the category averages (unrounded), displayed to 2 decimals. 2026-06-25 categories: Reasoning[theory_of_mind,zebra_puzzle,spatial,logic_with_navigation], Coding[code_generation,code_completion], Agentic Coding[javascript,typescript,python], Mathematics[AMPS_Hard,integrals_with_game,math_comp,olympiad], Data Analysis[consecutive_events,tablejoin,tablereformat], Language[connections,plot_unscrambling,typos], IF[paraphrase,simplify,story_generation,summarize]. Scores from different releases use different question sets and category definitions and are NOT directly comparable; each model row carries its release. Rows with release != 2026-06-25 are models absent from the latest release table, taken from the most recent release that contains them.
